text: Coffee with Ellie and Mei. Ellie's driving test is Thursday at 10am, third attempt, and she's properly nervous. Mei just got promoted to team lead. Remind me to text Ellie good luck Wednesday night.

Drinks after work. Noah's housewarming is Saturday 14 June from 7pm, new place in Leith. Aisha's bringing her boyfriend Reza. I'm doing a cheese board. Noah said his sister Joy might come up from Bristol with her new boyfriend, first time any of us will meet him. Party ends at midnight because of the neighbours.
Caught up with Graham on a call. His boss is leaving at the end of the month and he's been asked to cover. He sounded knackered. Daughter Freya has her grade 5 piano exam on 3rd of July.
Joy rang. Her dog Biscuit had his op yesterday morning and is home now, a bit groggy. She's hosting a small dinner on the 12th at half 7. Must reply about the dinner by Friday.

Lunch with Lachlan and Colm from the Glasgow office. Lachlan's moving to the client side in January. Colm is vegan now, so no steak place next time. They both hate the new timesheet system. Her brother Elijah is coming home that weekend too, he's just finished his first year at Durham and passed everything.
Emily's results day is 13 August at 8am. She's convinced she's failed chemistry. Her mum is driving her in. Don't forget to message her that afternoon to see how it went.
Sofia's 30th was meant to be a boat party on 21/06 but it's been called off, the boat company went bust. Doing drinks at hers instead. She wants a nice candle, apparently, Jo Malone ones.
Quick one. Dentist Tuesday at 9:15, then picking up the dry cleaning.
Chat with Hugo at the coffee machine. He had his performance review this morning and it went fine, small raise. His wife Elena is expecting in March. Should send congrats card for both.
Adriana Rossi, new client contact at the agency. Prefers calls to email, based in Milan, back in London on 2 October. Has two kids at uni.

Saw Tomás at football. Tomás, or Tommy as everyone calls him, has an audition for the National Youth Theatre on Saturday at 2pm. He's terrified, hasn't slept much. His sister Giulia is coming down to watch. Remind me to ring Tommy Friday evening to wish him luck. Also need to ask Giulia if she still wants the spare ticket for Sunday.

spans.text: audition for the National Youth Theatre
ask Giulia if she still wants the spare ticket

text: Aditi passed her theory test! Practical booked for 5 November at 8:40am. She's been practising with her uncle in his old Corsa.

Dinner at Omar and Yetunde's last night. They're doing a joint 40th on 18 May, garden do, kids welcome. Omar's started a pottery class and won't shut up about it. Yetunde's mum is staying with them for the summer. Dr Banerjee also wants a site visit on 18/11 at 10am. Rafael asked if I could join, I said yes.

Work drinks. Rafael said Dr Banerjee from the client is impossible, rejected the third draft. Rafael's presenting to their board Monday at 11. He's stressed. I should check in with him Monday afternoon.
Note to self: book the MOT before the 28th and cancel the gym membership.
Rang Helen. Her son Eli got into Edinburgh for medicine, offer came through this morning. She cried on the phone. Eli starts in September. Get him something for his room, maybe a decent desk lamp.

spans.text: Get him something for his room

text: Leah's leaving do is Thursday at 6pm at the Crown. She's off to Deloitte after eight years. Collection going round, chip in a tenner by Wednesday.

Simone and Duc are doing a housewarming on the 9th of August. Duc said bring nothing, Simone said bring wine. They've got a new kitten called Pickle. Simone's still waiting on her MA results, due end of the month. Simone's mum is flying in from Lyon for it and staying a fortnight, which Duc is pretending to be happy about.
Joe's stag was supposed to be Prague in April but it's off, he and Ava split up last week. He's staying at his brother's for now. Remind me to call Joe this weekend, just to see how he's doing.

Catch-up with Freya. She's sitting her ACCA exam on 8 December at 9am and her firm will only pay for one resit. Her partner Ryan is cooking all her meals so she can revise. She loves those salted caramel brownies from the market.

spans.text: salted caramel brownies from the market

text: Elijah from accounts mentioned his dad's retiring after 35 years at the post office. Party's at the rugby club on 26/09, evening. Elijah's organising a slideshow and wants old photos.

spans.text: retiring after 35 years at the post office

text: Ellie messaged. Passed!! First time. She's buying a little Fiat next week.
Mei invited me to her graduation dinner on 15 July at 7:30pm. Her parents are flying over from Taipei for it. Her brother Sam is coming too. Mei wants it low-key, no speeches.

Team meeting ran long. Our manager Graham announced the restructure consultation starts 1 November. Noah's role is at risk, he's worried about the mortgage. Hugo seems fine. Should take Noah for a coffee next week. Hugo thinks the consultation will drag on till February. Ava from HR is running the one-to-ones, first ones on 3 November at 9am.
Sorted the spare room this afternoon. Mum's coming to stay on the 2nd.
Aisha said her little girl has her first ballet show on Saturday morning at 10:30. Aisha's husband can't go, he's working, so she's taking her mum. Remember to ask Aisha on Monday how the show went.

spans.text: ask Aisha on Monday how the show went

text: Omar's grandad passed away on Sunday. Funeral is Friday 3rd at 1pm in Bradford. Omar's taking the week off. I need to send flowers to the family and sort cover for his clients.

Long call with Elena Novak. She's sitting the Life in the UK test on 22 May at 11am. Also she's applying for a new role at the hospital, interview's the week after. Her husband Petr thinks she's overdoing it. She's coeliac, remember for the dinner.
Colm's band have a gig at the Brudenell on 4 October, doors at 8. Lachlan and I are going. Colm's on bass, the drummer is his cousin.
Joy's daughter Ava did her grade 3 violin exam this morning. Results in about three weeks. Joy thinks she did well. Ava is mad about horses.
Helen's anniversary dinner, 25 years, is at the Ivy on 30 June. She's invited six of us. I'm doing the toast, apparently. Must write something before the 20th.

Giulia's dissertation hand-in is Friday at 4pm. She's been in the library till midnight all week. Her flatmate Adriana is bringing her food. Text Giulia Saturday morning to see how she's feeling. Reza says the team is mostly in Dublin so he'll be flying out on the 20th for a week of onboarding.

Reza is starting at Google on Monday. Very excited, slightly intimidated. His partner Yetunde says he's already bought three new shirts. Remind me to message Reza Monday night and ask how the first day went.

spans.text: message Reza Monday night and ask how the first day went

text: Haircut Saturday 11am. Then try and get to the garden centre before it shuts.
Bumped into Lachlan and his wife at Tesco. Their twins start nursery on 5 September. Lachlan is more nervous than the kids. They're thinking of moving to Fife next year.
Simone texted, her MA results came through. Distinction! Party at theirs Saturday evening to celebrate. Duc's doing a barbecue, weather permitting.
Hugo's leaving drinks were meant to be tonight but got called off, half the team has covid. Rescheduled to next Thursday at 5:30. Hugo's off to Lisbon for a month after he finishes.

Catch-up call with Ryan. His mum had her knee op on Tuesday, recovery is slow and she's frustrated. Ryan is driving up to Leeds every weekend. His sister Leah is helping in the week. I should ring Ryan's mum myself, she'd like that. Also Ryan's birthday is 17 March, he's been dropping hints about a coffee grinder.

spans.text: dropping hints about a coffee grinder

text: Aditi said her driving instructor cancelled again, so the test on the 5th might move. She's fed up. Her brother Noah offered to take her out in his car on Sunday morning.

spans.text: take her out in his car

text: Graham's daughter Freya has her GCSE mocks starting 1 December. Graham says she's fine but she's not. She wants to do vet science.
Dinner invite from Rafael and Simone, Friday 7 November at 8pm. Rafael is a bit of a wine bore, take something decent. Simone doesn't eat fish.
New starter on the team, Joe Brennan. Ex-teacher, retrained in data. Lives in Didsbury with his partner and a greyhound called Bean. Quiet but sharp.
Sofia's mock trial for her law conversion course is on 10 December at 2pm. She's competing against Duc's team. Duc is very smug about it. Wish Sofia luck the night before.
Emily's sister Ellie is getting married on 6 June next year. Save the date arrived today. Emily's maid of honour and stressing about the hen do already.

Spoke to Eli. His viva is on 19/11 at 10am, external examiner from Oxford. His supervisor Dr MacDonald thinks he's ready. He's been having panic attacks though. Remind me to check in on Eli the week before and send good luck the morning of.
Leah's new job at Deloitte is going well, she says. Manager is a bit hands-off. Her cat Mochi has started bringing in mice. She's thinking of doing a marathon next year.

Adriana called from Milan. Contract renewal meeting is 14 October at 3pm our time. She wants the updated deck by the 10th. Her boss Mr Andersson will join. Need to send Adriana the deck by Thursday. Her brother Hugo says she's been off since her divorce last year and could do with an evening out, so I said I'd go.
Book club at Mei's was cancelled, she's got flu. Next one at Aisha's, Tuesday 25 at 7pm.
Joy and her husband are hosting Christmas Eve drinks on the 24th from 6pm. Joy says it's the first year since her dad died that she's felt like doing it. Bring mince pies.
Tomás got his audition result. Into the National Youth Theatre! Rehearsals start in January in London. He's moving in with his aunt. Remember to congratulate him properly when I see him Saturday.
Got invited to Noah's 40th. Surprise party, Saturday 22 November at 7pm, at the cricket club. His wife Mei is organising, don't tell him. Noah loves whisky, maybe a nice Islay.

Talked to Duc Nakamura after the client call. Client wants everything by 31/10, which is mad. Duc's going on paternity leave on the 3rd of November, baby due early November. He's worried about handing over. Should offer to take the Henderson account off him.

spans.text: offer to take the Henderson account off him

text: Omar said his son Rafael passed his driving test this morning, at 9am, first go. Omar's terrified now. Rafael wants a Golf.
Freya's ACCA results come out 3 February at 7am. She's not sleeping. Text her that morning.
Groceries, pay council tax, and ring the bank about the card.

spans.text: ring the bank about the card

text: Elijah and Aisha had lunch with me. Elijah's wife is pregnant with their second, due in April. Aisha is training for a half marathon on 12 April. Elijah wants to start running too but has a bad knee. Aisha suggested a couch to 5k thing.

Ellie's having a small housewarming next Friday. Her flatmate Giulia is making a lasagne. Ellie's allergic to nuts, so nothing with pesto. She wants plants for the flat, a big monstera would go down well.

spans.text: big monstera would go down well

text: Long chat with Helen over lunch. She's applying for the head of department role, interview on 4 December at 2:30pm, and she's a nervous wreck. Her husband Graham thinks she's a shoo-in. If she gets it, she starts after Easter. Her mum's 80th is the weekend before the interview, so it's a busy few weeks. Remind me to ask Helen how the interview went and to get a card for her mum.

spans.text: ask Helen how the interview went
get a card for her mum

text: Yetunde told me her nephew is doing his Year 6 SATs in May. Her sister is panicking more than he is. Yetunde's moving to a bigger team at work in the new year.

Quick catch-up with Colm. His performance review is Friday at 4pm with his manager Elena. He thinks it's about the missed deadline. He's been really down lately. I should take Colm for a pint after the review.
